set -euo pipefail
export PATH="/Users/james/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"

# Claude Code Telegram Bot

**Status:** Active

## Overview

**Purpose:** Two-way Telegram-to-Claude Code bridge. Provides full Claude Code access from any device via Telegram, and enables conversational replies to Uptime Kuma alerts and cron notifications.
**Technology Stack:** Python 3.11, claude-code-telegram (v1.6.0), Claude Agent SDK, uv
**Key Dependencies:**
- Claude CLI (`/Users/james/.local/bin/claude`) for AI execution
- Telegram Bot API (bot: @QpbEh48E9kILrinbbot, name: "Loop")
- PAI webhook server (shares bot token, no conflict)

## Access

- **Host:** macmini (10.20.20.54)
- **Telegram Bot:** @QpbEh48E9kILrinbbot
- **Allowed Users:** 8404108011 (James only)
- **Working Directory:** `/Users/james/1-testytech/homelab`
- **Database:** `~/.claude/data/claude-telegram.db`

## Operations

### Start/Stop/Restart
```bash
# Start
launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.pai.claude-telegram.plist

# Stop
launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.pai.claude-telegram.plist

# Restart
launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.pai.claude-telegram
```

### Check Status
```bash
launchctl list | grep claude-telegram
```

### View Logs
```bash
tail -f ~/.claude/logs/claude-telegram-stdout.log
tail -f ~/.claude/logs/claude-telegram-stderr.log
```

## Configuration

- **Config file:** `/Users/james/1-testytech/claude-code-telegram/.env`
- **LaunchAgent:** `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.pai.claude-telegram.plist`
- **Startup wrapper:** `~/.claude/scripts/run-claude-telegram.sh`
- **Log rotation:** `/etc/newsyslog.d/pai.conf` (5 archives @ 1MB)
- **ENVIRONMENT=standalone** to prevent production overrides from stomping explicit .env values

## Bot Token Sharing

The webhook server and this bot share the same Telegram bot token without conflict:
- Webhook server uses `sendMessage` (stateless API call)
- This bot uses `getUpdates` (long polling)
- The startup wrapper runs `deleteWebhook` preflight to prevent stale webhooks from blocking polling
- Only two simultaneous `getUpdates` consumers would cause 409 errors

## Alert Reply Flow

1. Uptime Kuma fires alert to webhook server
2. Webhook server sends consolidated message via `sendMessage`
3. James replies to the alert message in Telegram
4. This bot picks up the reply via `getUpdates`
5. Telegram's `reply_to_message` includes the original alert text
6. Claude responds with homelab infrastructure context

The same reply flow works for cron notifications and any other message sent via the bot token.
